note: NOT VERIFIED - no registry data obtained. Consequently CIN/LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status and revenue are all null because they are not publicly confirmed by any source I could actually read - they are NOT null because the company was found to be non-existent. Per project rules, rejection requires positive evidence that the entity does not exist, is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt; absence of accessible data is not such evidence, so this company is NOT rejected and must be re-queued for verification with working search/registry access. Role is recorded as 'unknown' rather than manufacturer or trader because no MCA business-object classification or GST-based activity evidence was retrievable. The declared HS code 842890 (lifting/handling machinery) is retained as declared only and was not assessed, per the rule that HS mismatch is never a rejection ground. No revenue figures were estimated or inferred; audited accounts were not located. Recommended next step: manual lookup of the exact name on the MCA master-data portal and on a GST public profile to capture CIN, PAN (4th-character holder type), GSTIN and status.
